records.name: Schema version and metadata version helper
records.purpose: The schema version constant and the helper that computes the next per-record metadataVersion.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). Root exports SCHEMA_VERSION (string constant "1.0.0") and nextMetadataVersion(current: ComponentMetadata, next: Omit<ComponentMetadata, "metadataVersion">): number. The helper compares every field except metadataVersion and schemaVersion via JSON.stringify and returns current.metadataVersion + 1 on a change, otherwise the unchanged value; key order therefore affects the comparison.

records.name: Component metadata contract types
records.purpose: Type-only description of product component metadata: identity, per-framework API facts, accessibility, style, relationships, provenance reference and guidance.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). Root exports the types ComponentIdentity, PropFact, EventFact, FrameworkApi, ComponentApi, AccessibilityFacts, StyleIdentity, Relationships, ProvenanceRef, Guidance and ComponentMetadata. ComponentMetadata = ComponentIdentity & { api?, accessibility?, style?, relationships?, provenanceRef?, guidance? }. Identity carries name, category, description, schemaVersion, metadataVersion and packages for ng, react and vue (packageName, sourcePath). EventFact.mechanism is "output" | "callback-prop" | "emit". ProvenanceRef.package is "ng" | "react" | "vue" | "uix-styles". These are product component metadata types, distinct from the inventory schema in scripts/inventory/pilot-schema.json.

records.name: Metadata validator and result type
records.purpose: Runtime validator that establishes whether an unknown value conforms to the v1 ComponentMetadata shape, plus its result union.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). Root exports validateComponentMetadata(record: unknown, allRecords: unknown[]): ValidationResult and ValidationResult = { valid: true; record: ComponentMetadata } | { valid: false; errors: string[] }. It rejects unrecognized keys at each level, requires name, category, description and schemaVersion strings and a positive-integer metadataVersion, requires schemaVersion to equal SCHEMA_VERSION exactly, checks packages, api, accessibility, style, relationships and guidance shapes, flags duplicate names and unknown dependsOn targets within allRecords, and for provenanceRef reads docs/architecture/provenance/<package>.json from the repository (path resolved from the module location with node:fs) to check destinations exist.
